title: TikTok Air Fryer Bagel Chips
description: Crispy, flavorful bagel chips are cooked in the air fryer for maximum crunch.

steps.text: Slice the bagel, top to bottom, into 1/8 inch-thick rounds.
Add the bagel slices to a large bowl, then add olive oil, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, and grated Parmesan cheese. Stir until fully coated.
Preheat the air fryer to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Arrange the bagel slices in a single layer and cook for 5-7 minutes, flipping halfway through.
Move chips to a paper towel-lined plate to remove excess oil. Chips will crisp up as they cool down.

video.description: In this video, learn how to make perfect bagel chips in the air fryer. These crispy, crunchy snacks make an ideal scoop for dips, and you can also use them as croutons. Simply cut up the bagels, season the rounds with olive oil, spices, and cheese, then cook them in the air fryer until they reach textural perfection, and that doesn’t take long! Try different combinations of seasonings, bagels, and grated cheese until you achieve the perfect result.
